name: How do I choose the right contractor for my re-stucco project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my re-stucco project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor for your re-stucco project involves careful consideration. Look for contractors with specific experience in stucco work and a strong portfolio of completed projects. Verify their licensing and insurance to ensure they are properly qualified and protected. Request references from previous clients and check online reviews for feedback on their reliability and quality of work. Obtain detailed written estimates from multiple contractors, comparing not only cost but also materials specified, project timelines, and warranty information to make an informed decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a re-stucco contractor by verifying their experience, licensing, and insurance. Check references and reviews, and compare detailed written estimates from multiple companies.
